therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: suppression of periodic limb movements and restless legs syndrome symptoms
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Adults with restless legs syndrome and end-stage renal disease requiring hemodialysis
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Ratio from baseline to end of 2-week maintenance period in Periodic Limb Movement Index (PLMI)

results.effect_size: Treatment ratio 0.44 (95% CI: 0.22–0.88); Rotigotine PLMI ratio 0.51 vs Placebo 1.16
biomarker_changes: PLMI change from baseline: Rotigotine -23.7 movements/hour vs Placebo +10.3 movements/hour
PLMSAI change from baseline: Rotigotine -1.609 vs Placebo +4.634 movements/hour
Sleep efficiency change from baseline: Rotigotine +7.668% vs Placebo -2.850%
subgroup_findings: CGI Item 1 at end of maintenance: Rotigotine had 5 subjects rated 'Normal, not ill at all' vs 1 placebo; 4 Rotigotine vs 1 placebo rated 'Borderline ill'
IRLS sum score change from baseline: Rotigotine -15.9 vs Placebo -8.6
RLS-6 Scale 6 (daytime tiredness): Rotigotine -3.4 vs Placebo -1.6
safety_signals: Serious adverse events reported in rotigotine arm: abdominal pain, chest pain, foot fracture, anxiety, dyspnoea (each n=1/20)
Serious adverse event in placebo arm: gastrointestinal infection (n=1/10)

dose_info.schedule: Once daily; titrated weekly starting at 1 mg/24 h up to maximum 3 mg/24 h
dose_info.dose_modifications: Dose increased weekly during up-titration (up to 3 weeks); tapered by 1 mg/24 h every other day during taper period

context.indication: Restless legs syndrome with end-stage renal disease requiring hemodialysis
context.duration: Up to 3 weeks titration + 2 weeks maintenance + up to 4 days taper

subgroups.raw_descriptor: Among the most extremely ill subjects
